record.review_revision: T4 architecture r2, R3 unresolved settlement source visibility
changes: Slot candidate SQL exposes declared and frozen source subjects independently, accepting their union; it does not coalesce away the declaration or rewrite the frozen source.

The shared reducer matches an existing indexed declaration even when the resolver retains a different frozen source identity. For an existing A obligation key, its established uncertain-payment path now runs and propagates null paid/period-paid/remaining amounts.

Every included unresolved movement marks the overall shared result partially_established. If B has no matching A obligation key, B's own known obligation remains paid=0, remaining=100 while the global summary reports incomplete.

A nonempty candidate selection with no relationship to the requested subject returns the existing empty summary with explicit zero business/movement/line-relation counts; unrelated C is not contaminated by A/B issues.
record.contract_limits: No response fields, settlement resolution rules, frozen adoption rules, source amounts, declaration kinds, or DDL were added. No current-head fallback replaces the exact frozen pointer. Existing enums and the existing unknown reducer are reused.

synthetic_fixture.construction: Start with a typed synthetic book containing A/B obligations of 100 fen and two valid A payments (40 and 20). Copy it into SQLite memory. Temporary shadow calculation/edge tables change only the 40-fen frozen pointer and edge to B, preserving declaration A and the A obligation key. Persistent source facts and the original synthetic database are not altered by fault injection.
synthetic_fixture.scope: This deliberately damaged retained-record state is not claimed to be constructible through normal business write APIs. Actual QueryReads, selected accounting, normalized slot SQL, resolver, collection pagination, full reducer and summary are invoked without mocking their business decisions.
synthetic_fixture.expected: A has two items across pages and unknown paid/remaining; B sees the same damaged event, retaining B calculation/fact trace and the raw 40-fen declaration, with B's known obligation unchanged. Union scope counts the event once. Historical and current views use the same semantics.

findings: A page total_count=1 instead of 2: damaged 40-fen slot missing
A full/summary status=established instead of partially_established
